Transveg is a dynamically developing Polish transportation company. We specialize in the field of refrigerated international road transport and we can boldly admit that we are experts in that area. We always aim to be as quick as possible without sacrifice to the quality and safety of transported goods.
Through years of Experience we have learned our customers’ needs. We know that a top-notch service and the highest level of reliability in transportation planning are very important. Each of our customers is dear to us and therefore we always have an individual and tailor-made approach to every single freight we deal with.
Our values are investment, effort and constant search for best solutions regardless of situation. These is also how we build our team that you work with everyday.
Our main advantages are brand new fleet of trucks and a lengthy and trustworthy cooperation with a number of haulier, which provide their services professionally and timely. Thanks to our professional attitude there is nothing impossible for us and we can offer a comprehensive service to our valuable customers.
